tasks.analysis: Pottery is an ancient craft that involves shaping and firing clay in special wood-fired ovens (kilns) to create functional and decorative objects. Early pots were shaped by hand and heated in simple kilns, producing ceramics that lasted longer. As societies developed, techniques became more refined, with different cultures creating distinct styles. Over time, pottery evolved into both a practical craft and a significant form of artistic and cultural expression. Pottery has been practiced by cultures worldwide, reflecting their unique artistic traditions and functional needs. 陶器是一项古老工艺，通过在特制柴烧窑炉中塑形并烧制黏土，制成实用与装饰兼具的器物。早期陶器由手工塑形并在简易窑炉中加热，制作出的陶瓷更为耐用。随着社会发展，工艺日趋精湛，不同文化形成了独特风格。长期以来，陶器既作为实用工艺，也成为重要的艺术与文化表达形式。世界诸多文明都有制陶传统，反映出各自独特的艺术传统与实用需求。
